_meta.purpose: The exact O*NET task statements of the 15 anchor occupations used by the W-2 `wants` blocks in profiles.json. tests/test_path_eval.py asserts that every string in a wants tasks_more/tasks_less list is one of these, so a retyped or paraphrased task fails the suite instead of silently becoming a different instrument.
_meta.source: solverah-corpus/onet_corpus_20260916.documents.jsonl (F-1 corpus artifact, read-only). Only the occupations the new profiles anchor on are copied here; this is not a second corpus.
